name: Berkshire Hathaway, Inc.
summary:
Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) reported earnings of $6.02 per share on revenue of $101.81 billion for the . The consensus earnings estimate was $5.24 per share. The company beat consensus estimates by 14.89% while revenue grew 10.04% on a year-over-year basis.

Berkshire Hathaway and its subsidiaries engage in diverse business activities including insurance and reinsurance, utilities and energy, freight rail transportation, manufacturing, retailing and services.
subject: Berkshire Hathaway Beat Consensus Estimates
